name: paymob-integration
description: Expert, workflow-driven guidance for integrating the Paymob payment gateway across Egypt, UAE, KSA, and Oman. Routes by platform, onboarding, web/API, and native Mobile SDKs. Covers transaction, card-token, and subscription HMAC; reconciliation; advanced payment features; hardened checkout and webhook references; and ready-to-use code for Node.js, Python, PHP, .NET, Ruby, and frontend. Bundles Paymob's official MCP server for live account actions. Includes five setup, sandbox, test-data, error, and HMAC slash commands. Triggers even when no provider is named for a regional payment request.
